public_rationale: The categorical secrecy component is contradicted. On April 23, Anthropic publicly described reactive fixes to Claude's surrounding software, including the exact instruction implicated in degraded coding quality and its rollback. This meets the stated disclosure rule. It does not show that companies have escaped human correction or that the cycle will end. Indeed, the incident describes continued reactive correction. The proposed verdict is limited to “never disclose” under the stated reading.
limitations: This resolves the categorical secrecy component, not the indefinite-dependence component.
The intervention concerns the application prompt and surrounding software, not a demonstrated change to model weights or stored factual knowledge.
The report is a company disclosure, not an independent audit of correction practices.
If never disclose means incomplete transparency rather than no disclosure, the broader forecast remains unresolved.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: GenAI companies will endlessly play catch-up, using many humans to apply undisclosed patches to their LLMs as each new problem arises.

statement.excerpt: So they forever play a game of catchup. Using massive numbers of humans (exact numbers unknown), GenAI companies perpetually put band-aids that they never disclose on top of their LLMs, based on human corrections, fixing each new problem as it arises. But the cycle repeats, endlessly.
statement.document_title: Why ChatGPT can’t be trusted with breaking news

from_speaker: forever play a game of catchup
fixing each new problem as it arises
our_interpretation: The claim combines indefinite dependence on reactive human correction with a categorical assertion that the resulting patches are never disclosed.
I read patches on top of LLMs to include human-directed changes to application prompts and surrounding software that address newly reported model behavior.
No finite period of continued correction establishes that the cycle will continue forever.
A qualifying public disclosure can refute the categorical secrecy component without showing that the broader correction cycle has ended.
Massive numbers supplies no numerical threshold; I do not invent one.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishes unavoidable indefinite reliance on substantial human correction and concealment of the resulting patches. Continued correction over a finite observation period is insufficient.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A decisive, independently verified escape from the asserted correction cycle occurs, or a company publicly discloses a qualifying reactive patch, contradicting the categorical never-disclose component.
